summary.zh: 名词性从句（Noun Clauses）是在句中充当名词功能的从句，可作主语、宾语、表语或同位语。常见引导词包括 that, whether, if, what, who, whom, whose, which, when, where, why, how 等。对 PTE Academic 和 IELTS 考生而言，名词性从句非常重要，因为它能帮助考生在口语和写作中表达观点、解释原因、概括研究发现、转述信息以及构建复杂句。掌握名词性从句的关键是：使用陈述语序、判断从句在主句中的语法功能、区分 that 与 what、正确使用 whether 和 if，并避免中式英语中的重复主语或错误疑问语序。

structure.formula: Main clause + noun clause / Noun clause + main verb / Subject + linking verb + noun clause
structure.explanation: 名词性从句本质上相当于一个名词短语，但它包含主语和谓语。它可以出现在名词能出现的位置。例如，作宾语时常跟在 think, believe, argue, suggest, show, explain 等动词后；作主语时可放在句首，也常用形式主语 it 来避免句子头重脚轻；作表语时常跟在 be, seem, remain 等系动词后；作同位语时用来解释 idea, fact, claim, evidence, possibility 等抽象名词。需要特别注意，名词性从句内部通常使用陈述语序，而不是疑问语序。

examples.en: Many researchers believe that regular exercise improves cognitive performance.
examples.zh: 许多研究人员认为，规律运动能提高认知表现。

examples.en: What the data reveal is highly relevant to public health policy.
examples.zh: 数据所揭示的内容与公共卫生政策高度相关。

examples.en: The main concern is whether young people can access reliable information online.
examples.zh: 主要担忧是年轻人是否能够在网上获取可靠信息。

usage_scenarios.title: 作宾语：表达观点、看法和研究发现
usage_scenarios.description: 名词性从句最常见的用法是作动词宾语，尤其适用于议论文、学术写作和 PTE Summarize Written Text。常见动词包括 believe, argue, suggest, indicate, demonstrate, assume, claim, acknowledge 等。that 从句常用于引出完整观点，而 wh- 从句则用于引出具体信息。

examples.en: The report indicates that air pollution has become a major threat to urban residents.
examples.zh: 该报告表明，空气污染已经成为城市居民面临的主要威胁。

examples.en: Experts have not yet determined why the species is disappearing so rapidly.
examples.zh: 专家尚未确定该物种为何如此迅速地消失。

usage_scenarios.title: 作主语：突出信息或观点
usage_scenarios.description: 名词性从句可以位于句首作主语，常用于强调一个事实、问题或现象。在学术英语中，为了句子更自然，较长的主语从句常改写为 It is + adjective/noun + that/whether... 的结构。

examples.en: Whether governments should fund space exploration remains controversial.
examples.zh: 政府是否应该资助太空探索仍然具有争议。

examples.en: It is evident that technology has transformed the way people communicate.
examples.zh: 显而易见，科技已经改变了人们交流的方式。

usage_scenarios.title: 作表语：解释主语内容
usage_scenarios.description: 名词性从句作表语时通常出现在 be 动词或其他 linking verbs 后，用来说明主语的具体含义。这种结构常见于 IELTS Writing Task 2 的中心句以及 PTE Essay 的论点展开。

examples.en: The key issue is whether economic growth can be achieved without environmental damage.
examples.zh: 关键问题是经济增长是否能在不破坏环境的情况下实现。

examples.en: The reason is that many students lack effective time-management skills.
examples.zh: 原因是许多学生缺乏有效的时间管理技能。

usage_scenarios.title: 作同位语：解释抽象名词
usage_scenarios.description: 同位语从句常用于解释某个抽象名词的具体内容，例如 fact, idea, belief, assumption, evidence, argument, possibility, concern 等。它是学术写作中提高准确性和逻辑性的高频结构。

examples.en: There is strong evidence that early childhood education contributes to long-term academic success.
examples.zh: 有强有力的证据表明，早期儿童教育有助于长期学业成功。

examples.en: The idea that everyone should have equal access to healthcare is widely supported.
examples.zh: 人人都应平等获得医疗服务这一观点得到了广泛支持。

common_mistakes.wrong: I don't know what is the problem.
common_mistakes.correct: I don't know what the problem is.
common_mistakes.explanation: 名词性从句内部要使用陈述语序，而不是疑问语序。中文学习者常受“问题是什么”的中文顺序影响，把 be 动词提前。正确结构是 what + subject + verb。
that 只起连接作用，不在从句中充当成分；what 相当于 the thing that，在从句中可作主语、宾语或表语。这里从句缺少宾语，因此必须用 what。

common_mistakes.wrong: I am agree that online learning is useful.
common_mistakes.correct: I agree that online learning is useful.
common_mistakes.explanation: agree 是实义动词，不能写成 am agree。后面可接 that 从句表达同意的内容。

common_mistakes.wrong: The reason is because many people prefer convenience.
common_mistakes.correct: The reason is that many people prefer convenience.
common_mistakes.explanation: The reason is... 后面正式英语中通常用 that 引导表语从句，不推荐使用 because。because 可用于原因状语从句，例如 Many people choose online shopping because it is convenient。

common_mistakes.wrong: I wonder that whether this policy will work.
common_mistakes.correct: I wonder whether this policy will work.
common_mistakes.explanation: whether 本身可以引导宾语从句，不需要再加 that。中文学习者有时会把多个连接词叠加，这是不符合英语语法的。

common_mistakes.wrong: He asked me where did I live.
common_mistakes.correct: He asked me where I lived.
common_mistakes.explanation: 间接疑问句属于名词性从句，必须使用陈述语序。同时，如果主句是过去时，从句通常需要进行时态回移。

common_mistakes.wrong: It depends on if the government provides enough funding.
common_mistakes.correct: It depends on whether the government provides enough funding.
common_mistakes.explanation: 介词后通常用 whether，不用 if。depend on, discuss, argue about, be concerned about 等结构后接“是否”时，应优先使用 whether。

pte_usage.description: 名词性从句在 PTE Academic 中非常常见，尤其出现在 Summarize Written Text, Write Essay, Retell Lecture, Summarize Spoken Text 和 Read Aloud 中。考生需要用它准确转述信息、整合原因结果、表达研究结论，并避免简单句堆砌。在写作中，that 从句可用于概括作者观点，whether 从句可用于讨论争议问题，what 从句可用于突出核心内容。在口语中，使用清晰的名词性从句能提升 grammatical range and accuracy，但必须注意语序稳定，避免因追求复杂句而产生结构错误。
sections: Reading and Writing Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: It is widely believed that + clause.
It is essential that + subject + base verb.
A key question is whether + clause.
What is particularly important is that + clause.
The argument that + clause + is persuasive/problematic.
academic_patterns.translation: ……这一论点具有说服力/存在问题。

academic_patterns.pattern: There is growing concern that + clause.
The issue is not whether + clause, but how + clause.
academic_patterns.translation: 问题不在于是否……，而在于如何……

academic_patterns.pattern: This raises the question of whether + clause.
academic_patterns.translation: 这引出了一个问题，即是否……

ai_tips: 写作中如果句子开头的主语从句过长，可使用 It is clear that, It is likely that, It remains uncertain whether 等结构，使句子更符合学术英语习惯。
遇到 wh- 引导的名词性从句时，先检查从句内部是否为陈述语序，例如 what the author means, why this trend occurs, how the policy affects citizens。
在 PTE Summarize Written Text 中，可以用 The passage suggests that... 或 The author argues that... 快速概括原文核心观点。
区分 that 和 what：that 后面通常是完整句；what 后面的从句往往缺少主语、宾语或表语。
表达“是否”时，正式写作中优先使用 whether，尤其是在句首、介词后、whether or not 结构中。

practice_questions.question: 改错：I don't understand why does this problem happen.
practice_questions.answer: I don't understand why this problem happens. 解释：why 引导的是宾语从句，从句内部要使用陈述语序。

practice_questions.question: 选择正确句子：A. What he believes is controversial. B. That he believes is controversial.
practice_questions.answer: A. What he believes is controversial. 解释：从句中 believes 缺少宾语，因此用 what；that 不充当句子成分。

practice_questions.question: 用 that 从句翻译：许多专家认为，人工智能将改变未来的就业市场。
practice_questions.answer: Many experts believe that artificial intelligence will transform the future job market.

practice_questions.question: 用 whether 从句翻译：这个政策是否有效仍然不清楚。
practice_questions.answer: Whether this policy is effective remains unclear. 也可以写作：It remains unclear whether this policy is effective.

practice_questions.question: 合并句子：The study shows something. Regular sleep improves memory.
practice_questions.answer: The study shows that regular sleep improves memory.

practice_questions.question: 改写为形式主语 it：Whether children should use smartphones at school is debatable.
practice_questions.answer: It is debatable whether children should use smartphones at school.

practice_questions.question: 完成句子：The main reason is ______ many commuters prefer public transport.
practice_questions.answer: that。完整句：The main reason is that many commuters prefer public transport.

practice_questions.question: 判断正误并修改：The question is that students should pay university fees.
practice_questions.answer: 错误。可改为：The question is whether students should pay university fees. 解释：这里表达“是否应该”，应使用 whether。
